arguments:
{"code":"local floor=math.floor
local function resolve_attack(attacker,defender,skill)
 local function cl(x,lo,hi) if x<lo then return lo elseif x>hi then return hi else return x end end
 local crit_chance=attacker.crit_chance or 0
 local crit_mult=attacker.crit_mult or 150
 local pen_pct=attacker.pen_pct or 0
 local pen_flat=attacker.pen_flat or 0
 local hp=defender.hp
 local shield=defender.shield or 0
 local armor=defender.armor
 local resist=defender.resist or {}
 local guarding=defender.guarding or false
 local power=skill.power
 local element=skill.element or 'physical'
 local hits=skill.hits or 1
 local true_damage=skill.true_damage or false
 local seed=skill.seed or 0
 local diff=cl(attacker.level-defender.level,-10,10)
 local row
 if element=='fire' then row={fire=50,water=50,nature=200,neutral=100,ghost=100}
 elseif element=='water' then row={fire=200,water=50,nature=50,neutral=100,ghost=100}
 elseif element=='nature' then row={fire=50,water=200,nature=50,neutral=100,ghost=100}
 else row={fire=100,water=100,nature=100,neutral=100,ghost=0} end
 local m=row[defender.element] or 100
 local r=resist[element]
 if r==nil then r=0 end
 r=cl(r,-50,80)
 local rf=100-r
 local absorbed=0
 local resolved=0
 local crits=0
 local overkill=0
 local killed=false
 for k=1,hits do
  local p=power-20*(k-1)
  if p<10 then p=10 end
  local d=floor(attacker.atk*p/100)
  d=floor(d*(100+3*diff)/100)
  local isc=(seed+17*k)%100<crit_chance
  if isc then crits=crits+1; d=floor(d*crit_mult/100) end
  local immune=false
  if not true_damage then
   local pen=pen_pct
   if isc then pen=pen*2 end
   if pen>100 then pen=100 end
   local ea=floor(armor*(100-pen)/100)-pen_flat
   if ea<0 then ea=0 end
   d=floor(d*100/(100+ea))
   d=floor(d*m/100)
   d=floor(d*rf/100)
   if m==0 then immune=true end
  end
  if guarding then d=floor(d/2) end
  if d<1 and not immune then d=1 end
  local a=d
  if shield<a then a=shield end
  shield=shield-a
  local loss=d-a
  if a>0 and shield==0 then loss=floor(loss*125/100) end
  absorbed=absorbed+a
  resolved=resolved+1
  if loss>=hp then
   overkill=loss-hp
   hp=0
   killed=true
   break
  end
  hp=hp-loss
 end
 return {damage=defender.hp-hp,absorbed=absorbed,hp=hp,shield=shield,overkill=overkill,crits=crits,hits=resolved,killed=killed}
end
local function fmt(r)
 return string.format("{damage=%s,absorbed=%s,hp=%s,shield=%s,overkill=%s,crits=%s,hits=%s,killed=%s}",tostring(r.damage),tostring(r.absorbed),tostring(r.hp),tostring(r.shield),tostring(r.overkill),tostring(r.crits),tostring(r.hits),tostring(r.killed))
end
local r1=resolve_attack({atk=40,level=12,crit_chance=30,crit_mult=150,pen_pct=25,pen_flat=5},{hp=60,shield=10,armor=40,level=10,element='nature',resist={fire=20},guarding=false},{power=120,element='fire',hits=2,true_damage=false,seed=3})
local r2=resolve_attack({atk=90,level=3,crit_chance=50,crit_mult=200,pen_pct=40,pen_flat=10},{hp=300,shield=25,armor=60,level=20,element='fire',resist={water=-30},guarding=true},{power=100,element='water',hits=3,true_damage=false,seed=40})
local ok=logic_define('resolve_attack',resolve_attack)
return 'E1='..fmt(r1)..' E2='..fmt(r2)..' define='..tostring(ok)"}
